emails.title: Emails
emails.description: Email addresses to check, one per line.

datasetId.title: Dataset with emails
datasetId.description: Optional. A dataset from another Actor run (for example a website contact scraper) whose items contain emails. They are checked together with the list above.

emailField.title: Email field in the dataset
emailField.description: Name of the item field that holds the email. The field may be a string or an array of strings.

concurrency.title: Concurrency
concurrency.description: How many emails are checked in parallel. DNS answers are cached per domain.
